questions.prompt: A short daily plan is often more _____ than a long list that is never reviewed.
questions.explanation: 句意：简短的每日计划通常比从不回顾的长清单更高效。efficient是高效的；ordinary是普通的，nervous是紧张的，private是私人的。空格修饰plan，四个词词性相同，需要根据后面的比较对象判断。关键词never reviewed说明长清单不能带来良好的执行效率。常用搭配：an efficient plan / improve efficiency。
questions.hint: 先看比较结构 more…than，再判断哪一种计划更容易实际执行。

questions.prompt: The survey was designed to _____ the main reasons students missed the workshop.
questions.explanation: 句意：这项调查旨在确定学生缺席工作坊的主要原因。identify可直接接reasons，表示识别或确定原因；survive表示生存，consume表示消耗，guarantee表示保证，都不能准确表达调查发现原因的目的。was designed to后接动词原形。解题顺序：先找宾语，再选择与宾语语义搭配的动词。
questions.hint: 调查的目的是弄清原因；空格后的宾语是the main reasons。

questions.prompt: Students were encouraged to _____ in the discussion rather than remain silent.
questions.explanation: 句意：鼓励学生参与讨论，而不是保持沉默。participate in是参加、参与的固定搭配，与remain silent形成对比。decline是下降或拒绝，transform是改变，maintain是维持；后两者通常需要宾语，且不符合题意。记忆搭配：participate in a discussion，participation in group work。
questions.hint: 留意空格后的in，以及rather than remain silent表达的对比。

questions.prompt: The library offers a wide _____ of study spaces for different needs.
questions.explanation: 句意：图书馆为不同需求提供多种学习空间。a wide variety of表示各种各样的。solution表示解决方案，benefit表示益处，challenge表示挑战，不能组成这里表达种类繁多的短语。不要只看单个词，先识别a variety of这一搭配；wide可加强多样的程度。
questions.hint: 把a wide…of看作一个整体，表达空间种类很多。

questions.prompt: If the team _____ the data earlier, it would have avoided the mistake.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果团队早一点核查数据，就能避免这个错误。主句would have avoided提示过去未实现的结果，因此if从句用had checked。checks是一般现在时，will check是将来时，has checked是现在完成时，都与这一过去虚拟结构不对应。结构：If + 主语 + had done，主语 + would/could/might have done。
questions.hint: 主句是would have avoided，条件句与过去事实相反。

questions.prompt: The new system is easy to use, _____ makes it popular among first-year students.
questions.explanation: 句意：新系统易于使用，这使它受到一年级学生欢迎。which引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面“系统容易使用”这件事，并在从句中作主语。that不能用于这种逗号后的非限制性从句；what不能作为这里的关系代词；where是地点副词，不能充当makes的主语。先判断空格在从句里承担什么成分。
questions.hint: 逗号后补充评论前面整个事实，而不是描述地点。

questions.prompt: No method can _____ success unless the learner practices regularly.
questions.explanation: 句意：除非学习者经常练习，否则没有方法可以保证成功。guarantee success是保证成功。respond表示回应，通常接to；approach表示靠近或着手；abandon表示放弃。题目讨论练习与成功保证的关系，因此选择guarantee。unless相当于if…not，读句子时不要忽略其否定条件。
questions.hint: 空格后是success；unless表示必要条件没有满足时的结果。

questions.prompt: By the time the lecture began, most students _____ their seats.
questions.explanation: 句意：讲座开始时，大多数学生已经就座。began给出过去的时间点，take their seats发生得更早，故用过去完成时had taken。take是现在时，were taking强调当时正在进行，will take表示将来，都不能表达此前已经完成。by the time + 过去时，主句常用过去完成时描述先发生的动作。
questions.hint: 讲座开始是过去事件，就座发生在它之前。

questions.prompt: The guide gives _____ advice: concrete steps that students can put into practice immediately, rather than abstract theory.
questions.explanation: practical表示实用的、可实践的。句中concrete steps和rather than abstract theory直接解释了这一含义。accurate侧重准确，flexible侧重灵活，significant侧重重要或显著；这些性质不等同于可直接执行。完整句意：指南提供实用建议，即学生能立即实践的具体步骤，而不是抽象理论。原始题干语义较宽，本版补充了释义线索，减少多项看似成立的歧义。
questions.hint: 看冒号后的解释：具体步骤，能够立即付诸实践。

questions.prompt: Students should turn off notifications _____ they can focus on the task.
questions.explanation: 句意：学生应该关闭通知，以便专注于任务。so that引导目的状语从句，常与can/could连用。even though表示即使，as if表示好像，unless表示除非；它们分别表达让步、方式假设和条件，不能表达这里的目的。先判断两部分的逻辑关系，再选连词。
questions.hint: 关掉通知的目的是什么？后半句包含can。

questions.prompt: What changed by the end of the four-week test?
questions.explanation: 原文说投诉噪声的次数had fallen，而早晨访客人数had increased，故正确项是Noise complaints decreased。雇佣更多员工与原文did not hire more staff相反；早晨访客变少与increased相反；所有讨论室关闭没有依据，原文要求谈话使用group rooms。fallen与decreased构成同义替换。
questions.hint: 定位By the end of the test，比较两种变化方向。
questions.materialBody: A college library tested a quiet-hour system for four weeks. During the first hour after opening, students were asked to keep phones silent and use group rooms for conversation. The library did not hire more staff. Instead, volunteers placed clear signs near study areas and reminded visitors of the rule. By the end of the test, complaints about noise had fallen, while the number of morning visitors had increased. The library decided to continue the system but added one flexible discussion zone for students working together.

questions.prompt: Why did the library add a flexible discussion zone?
questions.explanation: 文章末句说明新增灵活讨论区是为了服务合作学习的学生，所以选择To support students working together。存放手机、培训新志愿者都没有被提及；替代安静时段与continue the system相矛盾。目的题应定位to/for/because等线索，不把同时出现的其他措施当成原因。
questions.hint: 答案在文章末句；关注for students working together。

questions.prompt: The second group made _____ progress—a large, clearly noticeable improvement—after changing its study routine.
questions.explanation: significant表示显著的，与large, clearly noticeable improvement对应。ambiguous表示含糊不清，negligible表示微不足道，controversial表示有争议；后者均不能表达题干明确给出的“大而明显的进步”。句意：改变学习习惯后，第二组取得了显著进步。题干补充程度解释后，不能再把“很小的进步”也视为可接受答案。
questions.hint: 破折号后的解释提供了进步程度的线索。

questions.prompt: 翻译：越来越多的大学生通过短时、规律的复习来巩固新词，而不是在考试前集中突击。
questions.correctAnswer: More and more college students reinforce new vocabulary through short, regular review sessions instead of intensive study just before an exam.
questions.explanation: 参考译文保留了三个信息点：越来越多的大学生、短时且规律的复习、不是考前集中突击。More and more可换成An increasing number of；reinforce new vocabulary也可用consolidate newly learned words。through后接名词短语，instead of后也用名词或动名词。regular不是普通的，而是规律的；intensive study强调集中强化学习。译法不唯一，按信息完整、语法和自然度自评，本题不进入客观题分数。
questions.hint: 先划分主语、巩固方式和对比方式；用instead of连接两种做法。
questions.guidance: 完成后对照参考思路与检查量表自评；本题不计入客观题分数。

questions.prompt: 用 80—120 个英文单词说明大学图书馆如何帮助学生提高学习效率。
questions.correctAnswer: 可从安静空间、清晰分区、延长开放时间、学习指导等方面组织内容，并用一个具体例子支撑观点。
questions.explanation: 这是一篇原创参考短文，采用总述—措施—例子—总结结构。第一项理由是减少干扰，第二项是将合作讨论与安静学习分区，再补充检索指导；For example用新生检索数据库的场景支撑观点。检查是否满足80—120词、至少两项措施、有具体因果或例子，以及主谓一致和衔接。可以提出不同措施，不需要照抄范文；只做自评，不给伪造的AI分数。
questions.hint: 先写图书馆的主要作用，再列两项措施，最后用具体场景收束。
questions.guidance: 完成后对照参考思路与检查量表自评；本题不计入客观题分数。
questions.referenceAnswer: A university library can help students study more efficiently in several ways. First, quiet areas reduce distractions and make it easier to concentrate. Second, clearly marked group rooms allow students to discuss projects without disturbing others. The library can also offer short workshops on finding reliable sources and planning research. For example, a first-year student may finish an assignment faster after learning how to search an academic database. These services should be easy to find and available at convenient times. With suitable spaces and practical guidance, the library becomes a partner in everyday learning.
rubric: 至少提出两项具体措施
包含一个例子或因果说明

questions.prompt: The evidence is still _____—unclear and open to opposing interpretations—so the committee should not make a final decision.
questions.explanation: ambiguous表示模糊的、可作多种解释的，题干unclear and open to opposing interpretations直接对应。coherent表示连贯，empirical表示以观察或实验为依据，inevitable表示不可避免；都不是不明确的意思。so引出暂不作最终决定的结果。原始题干较宽，本版加入明确释义线索，避免仅凭“实证证据也可能不足”的其他理解作答。
questions.hint: 破折号中的释义说明证据存在不止一种解释。

questions.prompt: The new platform may _____ cooperation between researchers in different cities.
questions.explanation: facilitate cooperation表示促进合作、让合作更容易。deteriorate是恶化，manipulate是操纵，reconcile是协调或使和解，常接差异或冲突；均不如facilitate符合平台便利协作的语境。句意：新平台可能促进不同城市研究者之间的合作。常见搭配还包括facilitate communication / learning。
questions.hint: 平台帮助不同城市的研究者合作，判断动词是促进还是恶化。

questions.prompt: The difference between the two results was _____: so small that it could safely be ignored in the analysis.
questions.explanation: negligible意为微小到可以忽略的，与so small that it could safely be ignored同义。persistent意为持续的，compelling意为令人信服的，legitimate意为合法或合理的；它们都不表示差异的大小接近于零。句意：两项结果间的差异可以忽略。注意negligible与neglect的词根联系，但不要把它译为被疏忽的。
questions.hint: 冒号后的解释强调差异非常小，可以忽略。

questions.prompt: The author presents a _____ argument that persuades initially skeptical readers, supported by several independent studies.
questions.explanation: compelling在argument前表示有说服力的。controversial是有争议的，ambiguous是含糊的，mutual是相互的，均不等于能说服读者。多项独立研究提供论据支持，进一步强化compelling。句意：作者提出了有多项独立研究支持的论点，说服了最初持怀疑态度的读者。
questions.hint: 关注persuades initially skeptical readers，即说服原本怀疑的读者。

questions.prompt: Had the city consulted residents earlier, the plan _____ less opposition.
questions.explanation: Had the city consulted residents earlier相当于If the city had consulted residents earlier，是对过去事实的虚拟假设。主句应用might have faced表示过去可能出现但没有出现的结果。will face是未来，has faced是现在完成，would face常用于现在或将来虚拟，均不匹配。句意：如果更早咨询居民，该计划可能会遇到较少反对。
questions.hint: 把Had the city…还原成If the city had…，确定虚拟条件的时间。

questions.prompt: Not until the second trial _____ how sensitive the instrument was.
questions.explanation: 正确结构是Not until the second trial did the researchers realize…。not until放在句首，主句将助动词did置于主语之前，实义动词还原为realize。正常语序的两个选项缺少倒装；had the researchers realized会错误地表达此前已经意识到，与直到第二次试验才意识到的时间关系冲突。注意倒装发生在主句，不是until后。
questions.hint: 否定意义的Not until在句首，主句需要部分倒装。

questions.prompt: Frequent retrieval practice can _____ newly learned information, making it less likely to be forgotten.
questions.explanation: reinforce表示加强、巩固，在这里是巩固已学信息。anticipate表示预期，perceive表示感知，accumulate表示积累；后者强调数量增加，不是已有信息更牢固。making it less likely to be forgotten进一步限定了巩固含义。句意：经常进行提取练习可以巩固新学信息，使其不易遗忘。
questions.hint: 后半句说明效果：减少遗忘，也就是巩固。

questions.prompt: The policy, _____ intended to reduce waste, produced an unexpected burden for small shops.
questions.explanation: although引出让步：虽然政策原本旨在减少浪费，却给小商店带来意外负担。although intended…省略了it was，因为其逻辑主语与the policy一致。because表达原因，unless表达条件，so that表达目的，都不能呈现预期与结果的反差。完整结构为although it was intended to reduce waste。
questions.hint: 原本想减少浪费，却造成负担，两个分句之间是什么关系？

questions.prompt: A clear research question is a _____ for designing a useful experiment.
questions.explanation: prerequisite表示先决条件，可用a prerequisite for doing something。hypothesis是研究假设，controversy是争论，perception是感知或看法；它们不直接表达设计实验之前必须满足的条件。句意：明确的研究问题是设计有用实验的先决条件。注意冠词a与可数名词prerequisite的搭配。
questions.hint: 先有明确研究问题，才能设计有用实验；这种关系叫必要的先决条件。

questions.prompt: What matters is not whether every attempt succeeds, but whether the team _____ from each result.
questions.explanation: 两个whether从句由not…but…连接，陈述一般规律，因此用learns，并与前面的succeeds保持时态一致。the team在此作为整体单数，动词加s。would learn需要相应虚拟或过去将来背景，had learned是过去完成，will have learned是将来完成，句中没有这些时间参照。重点是是否从每次结果中学习，而不是每次都成功。
questions.hint: 句子讨论一般规律，且与whether every attempt succeeds并列。

questions.prompt: Why can satellite data not determine tree locations by itself?

options.text: Residents refuse to share local knowledge.
Young trees always damage underground pipes.
Street conditions may create practical limits.
Satellite images cannot show any shade.

questions.explanation: 正确项是Street conditions may create practical limits。卫星图能展示需要阴影的地点，却不能独自解决地下管线、狭窄人行道等栽种限制。不能展示任何阴影过度否定了卫星数据的作用；居民拒绝分享经验没有依据；树木总会破坏管线中的always把限制条件夸大为必然结果。局限题应同时保留工具的作用与边界。
questions.hint: 找卫星数据的局限，留意underground pipes与narrow pavements。
questions.materialBody: As summers grow hotter, several cities are mapping where pedestrians can find shade. The maps combine satellite images with street-level observations, but planners warn that data alone cannot determine where trees should be planted. A location that appears empty may contain underground pipes, while a narrow pavement may be unable to support mature roots. Some cities therefore invite residents to report the routes they actually use. This local knowledge helps officials identify places where a small intervention—such as a fabric canopy or a row of young trees—could make walking safer without obstructing essential infrastructure.

questions.prompt: What does local knowledge help officials identify?

options.text: The exact age of every tree in the city.
Routes that should be closed permanently.
Neighborhoods that need more parking spaces.
Places where small changes could improve walking safety.

questions.explanation: 居民的本地经验帮助官员找出小规模变化就能改善步行安全的地点，所以选择Places where small changes could improve walking safety。文章没有讨论精确测量所有树龄、永久关闭道路或增加停车位。identify与找出位置形成对应，small changes与small-scale interventions是同义表达。不要把城市规划常见话题代入没有写出的信息。
questions.hint: 定位居民的实际行走路线，以及small changes的效果。
questions.materialBody: As summers grow hotter, several cities are mapping where pedestrians can find shade. The maps combine satellite images with street-level observations, but planners warn that data alone cannot determine where trees should be planted. A location that appears empty may contain underground pipes, while a narrow pavement may be unable to support mature roots. Some cities therefore invite residents to report the routes they actually use. This local knowledge helps officials identify places where a small intervention—such as a fabric canopy or a row of young trees—could make walking safer without obstructing essential infrastructure.

questions.prompt: Which intervention is mentioned in the passage?
questions.explanation: 文章实际提到fabric canopy与young trees，因此Installing fabric canopies是正确项。地下管线和狭窄人行道是限制，不是文章提出搬迁或全部拓宽的措施；替代卫星测绘没有依据，作者主张数据与本地经验结合使用。例子题注意区分“问题条件”和“解决行动”。
questions.hint: 干预措施题只需要核对原文实际列出的例子。
questions.materialBody: As summers grow hotter, several cities are mapping where pedestrians can find shade. The maps combine satellite images with street-level observations, but planners warn that data alone cannot determine where trees should be planted. A location that appears empty may contain underground pipes, while a narrow pavement may be unable to support mature roots. Some cities therefore invite residents to report the routes they actually use. This local knowledge helps officials identify places where a small intervention—such as a fabric canopy or a row of young trees—could make walking safer without obstructing essential infrastructure.

questions.prompt: A _____ system can continue to work without exhausting the resources it depends on.
questions.explanation: sustainable表示可持续的，与长期运作而不耗尽依赖资源的定义一致。persistent表示坚持或持续存在，elaborate表示精心设计或复杂，empirical表示经验或实证的；都没有资源可持续利用这一核心含义。常见搭配：sustainable development / a sustainable system。不要仅凭continue选择表示持续的persistent。
questions.hint: 关键词without exhausting the resources，长期运行而不耗尽资源。

questions.prompt: 翻译：城市规划者不仅需要实证数据，也需要理解居民如何感知风险，才能制定更具韧性的公共政策。
questions.correctAnswer: Urban planners need not only empirical data but also an understanding of how residents perceive risk in order to develop more resilient public policies.
questions.explanation: 参考译文以Urban planners作主语，not only empirical data but also an understanding…构成平行宾语；how residents perceive risk为understanding的内容，in order to说明制定公共政策的目的。empirical是实证的，resilient强调面对冲击后的恢复能力，不宜只译为灵活。可以改用need to understand residents' perceptions of risk，只要信息完整、搭配自然。翻译自评不计入客观分数。
questions.hint: 先写not only…but also…并列两种需要，再用in order to引出目的。
questions.guidance: 完成后对照参考思路与检查量表自评；本题不计入客观题分数。
questions.referenceAnswer: Urban planners need not only empirical data but also an understanding of how residents perceive risk in order to develop more resilient public policies.
rubric: 准确表达 not only... but also...

questions.prompt: 用 120—160 个英文单词讨论：高校是否应把“可持续学习习惯”纳入新生教育。
questions.correctAnswer: 可先界定可持续学习习惯，再讨论其对时间管理、心理健康和长期学习效果的价值，同时回应“课程已很拥挤”的反方观点。
questions.explanation: 原创参考文先明确赞成立场，再界定可持续学习习惯；两个理由分别涉及压力管理和长期记忆。Some people argue引出反方，However回应以短工作坊嵌入现有课程，不忽视课表负担。结尾呼应长期学习和身心状态。自评检查120—160词、至少两个展开理由、回应反方、首尾立场一致；可以反对，但必须论证连贯。范文不是历年真题答案，也不是唯一标准。
questions.hint: 表明是否赞成，展开两个理由，再回应课程已经拥挤的反对意见。
questions.guidance: 完成后对照参考思路与检查量表自评；本题不计入客观题分数。
questions.referenceAnswer: Universities should introduce sustainable study habits during freshman orientation. These habits include planning small daily tasks, taking regular breaks and reviewing information over time. They help students manage demanding courses without depending on last-minute preparation. First, a realistic routine makes large assignments less stressful. Second, spaced review allows students to retain knowledge that they will need in later courses. Some people argue that orientation programmes are already crowded. However, universities do not need to add a long compulsory course. A short workshop, followed by practical examples in existing classes, can give students a useful starting point. Students should also be encouraged to adjust their plans when their workload changes. By teaching manageable habits early, universities can support both academic progress and long-term wellbeing.
rubric: 回应一个可能的反方观点
